note: Round 16 (2026-10-31): the operator, 2026-10-30: "need a different sound for artifact creatures and colorless creatures." Two new voices, the generic layer a creature resolves with: g.creature.artifact for an artifact creature whatever its colours (C|artifact-creature's clank plays on top), g.creature.colourless for a colourless creature that is not an artifact, an Eldrazi (C|creature on top). Both fall back to g.creature, whose keepers are one short low grunt, so these are as short: one sound of the creature itself, not a landing (the thud follows). The colourless voice was re-rolled (seed 16110) asking for a half-second sound: 12 of the first 15 came out as blips under 0.25 s, the single-hit suffix fighting a drone.
